name: A Pocketful of Snow
source:
A hobby botanist comes across snow-covered ruins in the middle of summer and goes to investigate.

[From [url=https://glueblade.itch.io/a-pocketful-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]

一位業餘植物愛好者在盛夏偶然發現了一處被雪覆蓋的廢墟，決定前去一探究竟。
